channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Australian Dollar comes under pressure as US Dollar regains ground
item.description: AUD/USD falls to around 0.7000 on Monday at the time of writing, down 0.30% on the day, as a rebound in the US Dollar (USD) outweighs the support provided by Chinese economic data for the Australian Dollar (AUD).

item.title: Federal Reserve: Data driven rate path – HSBC
item.description: HSBC strategists note that the Federal Reserve (Fed) left policy rates unchanged in July, with markets now assigning a two-thirds probability to a September hike.

item.title: Indian Rupee gives back major early gains while approaching closing bell
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) surrenders a majority of its early gains against the US Dollar (USD) near the closing session on Monday. The USD/INR is slightly lower at near 95.35, having recovered from its over three-week low of 95.15.

item.title: WTI stays lower near $78.50 ahead of US-Iran peace talks 2.0
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, trade 7.4% lower at around $78.50 during the European trading session on Monday. The Oil price holds onto its opening losses, driven by the announcement of a ceasefire 2.0 between the United States (US) and Iran.

item.title: Gold struggles to hold gains amid mixed US-Iran headlines, hawkish Fed
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) starts the week on a positive note, although buyers lack conviction as markets weigh conflicting US-Iran headlines and look ahead to US employment data for fresh clues on the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy outlook.

item.title: Fed’s Williams: Affirms confidence for inflation to return to 2% target
item.description: The remarks from New York Federal Reserve (Fed) Bank President John Williams, in an interview with Reuters that took place on Friday and was released during the European trading session on Monday, signal that he was confident about inflation returning to the central bank’s 2% target.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar eases as markets focus on US-Iran talks
item.description: NZD/USD trades around 0.5870 on Monday at the time of writing, down 0.11% on the day.

item.title: US ISM Manufacturing PMI is expected to show strong factory activity in July
item.description: Investors are attentive to the US Institute for Supply Management (ISM) on Monday, as it releases July’s Manufacturing Purchasing Managers Index (PMI).

item.title: Euro area: Services PMI and inflation risks – BNY
item.description: Geoff Yu at BNY argues that the lack of further Fed tightening has eased global financial conditions and partially offset European Central Bank (ECB) tightening, but European inflation dynamics remain distinct from the U.S.

item.title: British Pound eases to 1.3450 area following downwardly revised Manufacturing PMI data
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is trimming previous gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, returning to the mid-range of the 1.3400s down from fresh seven-week highs, above 1.3500 earlier on the day.

item.title: Gold: Explosive phase, muted correction – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank Research analysts Michael Hsueh and Bryant Xu argue that Gold has been in an explosive price phase since August 2024, but recent moves suggest a muted correction.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Monday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $58.38 per troy ounce, up 1.37% from the $57.59 it cost on Friday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD struggles to extend opening gains amid hawkish Fed bets
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) opens strongly due to a sharp decline in oil prices, but struggles to extend gains beyond $58.68 during the day. At press time, the Silver price is up 1% to near $58.20.

item.title: Oil: prices slide on halted strikes – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank strategists report that Brent Oil opened over 7% lower under USD84 into the Asian session after President Trump said the United States (US) would hold off on new strikes against Iran.

item.title: Swiss Franc weakens following soft inflation, manufacturing data
item.description: USD/CHF extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 0.8090 during the European hours on Monday. The pair remains on a stronger footing as the Swiss Franc (CHF) holds onto losses following the release of soft domestic inflation and manufacturing data.

item.title: Gold bulls seem hesitant amid rebounding USD; receding Fed hike bets limit the downside
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its sideways consolidative price move through the first half of the European session and trades above the $4,050 level following a modest bullish gap on Monday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention fears cap losses against US Dollar – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank's Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley discusses recent joint intervention by Japan’s Ministry of Finance (MoF) and the United States (US) Treasury to support the Japanese Yen (JPY) and its implications for USD/JPY.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Defends 200-day SMA below mid-109.00s after range breakdown
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross attracts heavy follow-through selling and touches its lowest level since late March, around the 109.40-109.35 region at the start of a new week.

item.title: Euro strengthens against Canadian Dollar despite mixed German data
item.description: EUR/CAD edges lower after opening with a bullish gap, remaining in the positive territory and trading around 1.6180 during the European hours on Monday. The currency cross is holding its ground as the Euro (EUR) remains resilient despite mixed economic data from Germany.

item.title: Swiss Franc: inflation undershoots SNB outlook – Nomura
item.description: Nomura strategists note that Swiss Consumer Price Index (CPI) slowed to 0.4% year-on-year in July, helped by weaker car fuel prices and easing imported energy costs.

item.title: Euro remains near seven-week highs after downwardly revised Eurozone Manufacturing PMI
item.description: The Euro (EUR) posts moderate losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, trading at 1.1525 at the time of writing, but standing close to the seven-week highs, at 1.1556 hit earlier on the day.

item.title: Euro: Fed uncertainty limits gains against US Dollar – ING
item.description: Chris Turner at ING argues EUR/USD should be performing better given solid Eurozone data, lower Oil prices and Japanese US Dollar (USD) selling, but notes possible US activity in EUR/JPY as a short-term drag.

item.title: Equities: AI reassessment shakes global markets – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists highlight a sharp reassessment of the AI (Artificial intelligence) trade with semiconductor and Korean equities suffering steep monthly losses despite strong YTD gains. European stocks outperformed as sector rotation and solid Eurozone growth supported broader indices.

item.title: Dow Jones futures advance as oil prices fall on US-Iran diplomatic signals
item.description: Dow Jones futures gain 0.54% to trade around 52,920 during European trading hours on Monday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures rise 0.49% to trade near 7,550, while Nasdaq 100 futures advance 0.64%, trading near 28,590.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Joint intervention reshapes FX dynamics – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank analyst Michael Pfister examines recent joint US–Japan intervention to support the Japanese Yen. He notes confirmation that US authorities helped Japan and that further actions are possible, but constrained by IMF rules.

item.title: Japanese Yen outperforms its peers amid speculation of fresh US-Japan intervention
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades sharply higher against its major currency peers during the European trading session on Monday.

item.title: WTI trades below mid-$78.00s, down nearly 8% for the day amid Iran peace deal hopes
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – struggles to register any meaningful recovery and sticks to heavy intraday losses through the early part of the European session on Monday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index drops to near $77.50 due to Japanese FX interventions
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground after three days of gains and trading around 101.50 during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: British Pound: Rally may stall near 1.3555 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang highlights GBP/USD’s volatile session, with a spike from 1.3401 to 1.3481 and scope for further gains toward 1.3520, though overbought conditions may cap upside.

item.title: Iran's Baghaei: No talks with US currently regarding Hormuz
item.description: Remarks from Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson, Esmail Baghaei, released during the European trading session on Monday, indicate that Tehran is in no discussions with the United States (US) regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, a critical chokepoint for almost 20% of global energy supp
